title: ADR-0113 D5: name the managed package install as the deliberate relax for a sealed package object
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRmmALkM1ftZxdVatQ

Filing gate: ④ follow-up owed by PR #33769 (Part of #33724). Named in review-b PASS 6892884183 ("a governed card for the one-line ADR-0113 D5 amendment") and in contract review 6892876561 ("The D5 sentence naming the install is governed text, so it is owed to the seat as a follow-up card and is not edited here"). It waited on #33382, which edited the same passage and is merged.

## What the ADR says today

`docs/adr/0113-required-write-contract-vs-column-constraint.md`, D5, lines 195–199 on origin/main: a `required: true` field that writes `storage: { notNull: false }` has its stricter column reported (`relax_not_null`, `needs_confirm`, never auto-applied), "and the publish of that declaration applies the relax, being the deliberate relax named above."

## What the code does since #33769

A sealed package object cannot be published by the author. The managed install or upgrade of its package through the install-local door now applies that same relax, for the columns the installing package's own body declares `notNull: false`, through `SqlDriver.relaxDeclaredNotNull`. A boot or rehydrate never applies it. So D5 names one deliberate act, and the code honours two.

## Expected

One sentence in D5 naming the managed install or upgrade of the package as the same deliberate relax for a package object. Tier H: governed text under docs/adr, so the maintainer's record is required. No code change.
